definition: Adaptability is the capacity to adjust one's methods or behavior when requirements, circumstances, or available information change.
example: When a venue becomes unavailable, an organizer redesigns the event for a smaller room without dropping its essential activities.

definition: Attention to detail is the capacity to notice and verify small elements whose omission or inconsistency could affect the result.
example: A payroll reviewer catches a transposed digit in an employee's recorded hours before the payment goes out.

definition: Causal reasoning is the ability to judge whether a change or event produces an outcome rather than merely accompanying it.
example: An analyst compares randomly assigned groups to determine whether a new reminder actually increased attendance.

definition: Emotional stability is a tendency to maintain relatively steady emotional responses and recover composure under stress.
example: A dispatcher remains composed during a surge of calls and continues applying the same triage criteria.
sense_note: Better understood as a disposition than as a discrete cognitive ability.

definition: Being goal-oriented is a tendency to organize and prioritize work around a specified objective.
example: A tutor uses the student's target reading level to choose exercises and measure progress each week.
sense_note: The adjectival label describes a work orientation.

definition: Ingenuity is the capacity to devise a resourceful solution when standard methods or available resources are insufficient.
example: A teacher turns spare cardboard and rubber bands into a working model of a lever for class.

definition: Patience is the capacity to tolerate delay, repetition, or frustration while continuing to act deliberately.
example: A mentor lets a learner work through several attempts before offering another hint.

definition: Quick learning is the capacity to acquire and apply unfamiliar information or procedures with relatively little instruction or practice.
example: After a short demonstration, a technician correctly uses an unfamiliar inventory screen to receive a shipment.

definition: Resilience is the capacity to recover or adapt after setbacks, adversity, or sustained pressure.
example: After a prototype fails a trial, a team member processes the feedback and returns to the work with a revised plan.

definition: Being results-oriented is a tendency to judge work by its demonstrated outcomes rather than by activity alone.
example: A support lead checks whether a new help page reduced repeat questions, not just how many articles were published.
sense_note: The adjectival label describes a work orientation.

definition: Self-confidence is trust in one's capacity to act or exercise judgment in a situation, without implying that the judgment is correct.
example: A junior designer explains a design choice to a review panel while remaining open to counterevidence.
sense_note: Better understood as a disposition or belief than as a discrete cognitive ability.

definition: A self-starter identifies and begins useful work without needing detailed instructions or repeated prompting.
example: A new coordinator notices unanswered inquiries and creates a queue to track and route them.
sense_note: The label names a person characterized by initiative.

definition: Spatial-temporal reasoning is the ability to infer how positions, shapes, or spatial relationships change over time.
example: A player predicts where a bouncing ball will reach the edge of the court after it strikes a wall.

definition: Being success-driven is a tendency to seek achievement and persist in pursuit of a high standard of performance.
example: After falling short of a benchmark, a runner adjusts training and works toward a measurable improvement.
sense_note: The label describes motivation rather than a discrete ability.

definition: Being team-oriented is a tendency to coordinate one's contributions with others in support of shared goals.
example: An engineer documents a handoff early so the next team can continue without waiting for a meeting.
sense_note: The adjectival label describes a work orientation.
